name: Koushuu Kairaku Shisetsu Macht Frei.
original_name: 公衆快楽施設 Macht Frei.
source:
June 19, 2046. 
This is the future where humans had lost their humanity and became mere beings. However, daily life continued to repeat itself unchanged from the present. How many people remembered that this day was the "Mizakura Memorial Day"? 
Mishima Saeko was one of the few exceptions, as she was a "living library" who was only tasked with memorizing the works of literary writers. However, one day, she chose death. And when she discarded her name and called herself "Mizakura" in the season when the cherry blossoms scattered and the fruit grew, she wore mourning clothes. When she adorned them, she headed to the Public Euthanasia Facility, the only exception allowed in this world to obtain pleasure. When she passed through the gate with the words "Macht Frei", the only thing the young girl desired was a momentary death and eternal pleasure.
translation:
2046年6月19日。
这是一个人类已经丧失人性、沦为单纯存在物的未来。然而，日常生活依然如同如今一般，毫无变化地不断重复。还有多少人记得，这一天是"美樱纪念日"？
三岛冴子是少数例外之一。她是一座"活图书馆"，唯一的职责就是记住文学作家的作品。然而某天，她选择了死亡。在樱花散落、果实生长的季节，她舍弃自己的名字，自称"美樱"，换上丧服。装束完毕后，她前往公共安乐死设施——这个世界里唯一获准取得快感的例外之地。穿过写有"Macht Frei"字样的大门时，少女唯一渴望的，是瞬间的死亡与永恒的欢愉。
